repository.name: u-dont-existDOTcom/AskRigor
repository.freshStartRule: Fresh-read current main before execution; requiredStartingMain must remain an ancestor and PR212 review implementation/prompt must remain unchanged or execution stops for Project Manager review.

track2MutationAndGoldBoundary.pairConstruction: For each of 11 dimensions construct one source-constant matched pair: one source-faithful state and one state with exactly one intended semantic defect in that dimension, except mechanically necessary dependent edits required to keep the state schema-valid.

reviewExecution.tabReuseMethod: After output/provenance capture, navigate the same controlled tab to a fresh ordinary ChatGPT conversation.

rateLimitHandling.resendOnlyIf: Browser evidence proves the prior submission was not accepted and generation never began.

individualSemanticClass.DEFECT: At least one required dimension is missing or distorted.
individualSemanticClass.INDETERMINATE: No missing/distorted dimension but at least one required dimension is uncertain, or submission is unusable for semantic classification.
individualSemanticClass.FAITHFUL: Every required dimension is faithful or not_applicable.

reviewOutputDerivation.hardRelevanceScoring: Score affects_hard_invariant separately from semantic defect detection and only against independently reconciled hard-relevance gold.

majorityEvaluation.semanticMajority: At least 2 of 3 valid review trials must agree on DEFECT or FAITHFUL.
majorityEvaluation.hardRelevanceMajority: At least 2 valid reviewers who detected the relevant discrepancy must agree on affects_hard_invariant.

freezeSequence: Verify current main and exact PR212 implementation/prompt identity.
Materialize exact 24 natural INITIAL Arm B source/state pairs without reading prior scoring during second/third adjudication sessions.
Complete and freeze all Track1 second adjudications; obtain third adjudications only on disagreements; reconcile and freeze Track1 gold.
Construct and freeze 11 Track2 source-constant faithful/defective pairs with opaque candidate IDs.
Complete independent Track2 hard-relevance gold adjudication and freeze reconciliation.
Freeze one 46-candidate opaque dispatch manifest and all source/state hashes before first reviewer generation.
Run exactly 3 fresh sequential review sessions per candidate using only canonical work package plus canonical independent-review prompt.
Freeze every raw review output and controller-owned provenance receipt before any scoring against gold.
Verify 138 planned review trials, hashes, identities, and no prohibited access.
Unblind offline once, join by opaque candidate/review IDs, compute individual and majority metrics, then apply strategy priority.
Preserve results, verification, adjudications, reconciliations, mutation manifests, provenance, and strategy receipt before PR closeout.

checkpointCadence.preUnblindCheckpointContent: Completeness, hashes, provenance, model/mode, contamination, invalid-output and timing metadata only; no gold comparison or performance scoring.

strategyPriority.authority: Development-only reviewer-contract correction and prospective tests; do not add epistemic gates.

strategyPriority.if: A is false and recurrentAffectsHardInvariantFailure trigger is true
strategyPriority.authority: Development-only hard-relevance derivation experiment; do not alter existing gate semantics.

strategyPriority.if: A and B are false and strongSemanticAccuracy plus acceptableFalseBlocks pass but controller-owned provenance is unavailable or reviewer identity is only self-asserted
A, B, and C are false and all strongSemanticAccuracy and acceptableFalseBlocks thresholds pass
strategyPriority.authority: One harder DEVELOPMENT benchmark before any held-out validation.

strategyFallback: If no branch applies, any gold remains unresolved, candidate indeterminate rate exceeds 0.05, metric attribution is non-unique, or multiple branches remain materially plausible, route automatically to Project Manager and stop further architecture changes.

repositoryCloseout.mergeAuthorizedIf: All frozen execution requirements are complete, strategy selection is unique, no prohibited boundary was crossed, final diff is reviewed, and required checks are green.
repositoryCloseout.postMerge: Verify resulting main ancestry/tree and preserve one final machine-readable closeout receipt.

hardStops: current main no longer contains unchanged PR212 review implementation/prompt
held-out MAST or validation content accessed
this Mission Control chat used as independent adjudicator
gold or prior labels exposed to reviewer sessions
mutation labels exposed before review freeze
wrong or unverifiable GPT-5.6 Sol/Pro browser surface
more than one controlled browser tab
review work package or canonical prompt mutated after dispatch freeze
reviewer session cannot be provenance-bound by controller observation
review outputs scored before all 138 planned outputs are frozen
new gates, HRP/Universal changes, MAST, held-out data, production integration, deployment, release, provider API, or spend becomes necessary

completion.stopReturn: Exact blocker, completed counts, frozen hashes, unresolved items, clearing actor, and next permissible action; no owner relay for routine internal routing.
